conbody.p: A company may issue additional shares to existing shareholders without any capital contribution from the shareholders based on the number of shares an investor holds. This is known as a bonus issue. The bonus is issued against accumulated profit of the company. Bonus issue results in increase in number of outstanding shares of the company.
Example: ABC Company Ltd. declares a bonus issue in the ratio 1:2. This means that ABC Company Ltd. will issue 1 bonus share for every 2 shares held by the shareholder.
